You can end up with more than your plan allows: you moved to a smaller plan, or the plan changed. This page says what happens. The rule is the same each time: what is in use keeps working, and nothing new is added beyond the limit.

## What happens at once

- People, spaces and API keys that already exist keep working.
- You cannot add a person, a space or an API key beyond the limit.

## After 14 days

If you are still beyond the plan after 14 days, the last added are held out:

| What you hold too many of | What happens |
|---|---|
| **People** | The person added last can no longer sign in. |
| **API keys** | The key made last stops working. |
| **Spaces** | The space made last is read only, except for the owner. |

Nothing is deleted. Put it right and everything is back.

## The banner

The Studio shows a banner **Beyond your plan**, for those who manage it. It says what is over, for example "N people for a plan of M", and from which date the last added is held out. It also says what to do: deactivate someone, revoke keys, archive spaces, or choose a bigger plan. After the date, the banner says "Since" that date.

## Put it right

- Deactivate people in **Administration** > **People**.
- Revoke keys in **API keys**.
- Archive spaces in **Spaces**.
- Or choose a bigger plan in **Subscription**.

See [People, groups, roles and spaces](/docs/administration/people-groups-roles-spaces/), [Your account and API keys](/docs/administration/your-account-and-api-keys/) and [Subscription](/docs/administration/subscription/).
